title: PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to Dependent Audit of LAwell Program for Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-26.
text:

PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to Dependent Audit of LAwell Program for Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-26.
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the October 5, 2026 Personnel Department report relative to Dependent Audit of LAwell Program for FY 2025-26.

Not applicable.

summary: The Council will close out, without further action, a Personnel Department report on a dependent audit of the LAwell program for fiscal year 2025-26.

details.action: Note and file Personnel Department report

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 23, 2026)
